codeserverImage.description: Image of the code-server container of the `addons.codeserver` addon.

gluetunImage.description: Image of the Gluetun VPN container of the `addons.gluetun` addon.

kubectlImage.description: Image with `kubectl`, available to charts that need it in a container or init container through `imageSelector: kubectlImage`.

mariadbClientImage.description: Image of the mariadb client in the init container that waits for the `mariadb` dependency.

mongodbClientImage.description: Image of the mongodb client in the init container that waits for the `mongodb` dependency.

netshootImage.description: Image of the netshoot container of the `addons.netshoot` addon.

postgres15Image.description: PostgreSQL 15 image for CNPG clusters. Selected with `cnpg.$name.type: postgres` and `pgVersion: 15`.

postgres16Image.description: PostgreSQL 16 image for CNPG clusters. Selected with `cnpg.$name.type: postgres` and `pgVersion: 16`.

postgresClientImage.description: Image of the postgresql client in the init container that waits for the CNPG clusters.

postgresPostgis15Image.description: PostgreSQL 15 image with PostGIS for CNPG clusters. Selected with `cnpg.$name.type: postgis` and `pgVersion: 15`.

postgresPostgis16Image.description: PostgreSQL 16 image with PostGIS for CNPG clusters. Selected with `cnpg.$name.type: postgis` and `pgVersion: 16`.

postgresVectorchord15Image.description: PostgreSQL 15 image with VectorChord for CNPG clusters. Selected with `cnpg.$name.type: vectorchord` and `pgVersion: 15`.

postgresVectorchord16Image.description: PostgreSQL 16 image with VectorChord for CNPG clusters. Selected with `cnpg.$name.type: vectorchord` and `pgVersion: 16`.

postgresVectors15Image.description: PostgreSQL 15 image with pgvecto.rs for CNPG clusters. Selected with `cnpg.$name.type: vectors` and `pgVersion: 15`.

postgresVectors16Image.description: PostgreSQL 16 image with pgvecto.rs for CNPG clusters. Selected with `cnpg.$name.type: vectors` and `pgVersion: 16`.

tailscaleImage.description: Image of the tailscale container of the `addons.tailscale` addon.

ubuntuImage.description: Image of the init containers that set permissions (`autoperms`).

valkeyClientImage.description: Image of the valkey client in the init container that waits for the `redis` dependency.

scratchImage.description: Empty scratch image, for helper containers.

wgetImage.description: Image with `wget`, used by the init containers that wait for the `clickhouse` and `solr` dependencies.

redisClientImage.description: Image of the Redis client. Not read by common, the `redis` wait container uses `valkeyClientImage`.

openvpnImage.description: Image of the OpenVPN client, for the OpenVPN addon.

wireguardImage.description: Image of WireGuard, for the WireGuard addon.

description: Images of the addons, the dependencies and the helper containers of common. A container selects one with its `imageSelector`, the name of the image key.
